One `pricing:` list with optional token/date bounds is enough.","rejected":"Rejected the other engine's `pricing_schedule: [period -> tiers -> ...]` plan. Too much nesting for a mostly-flat 12-entry config, introduces a migrator dependency, and preserves a silent disagreement trap during the transition."},"d2_disagreement":{"validator_rule":"Canonicalize to `pricing` rows first, then reject if legacy flat `input_cost_per_1m` / `output_cost_per_1m` are present and do not exactly match the sole row; if `pricing` has more than one row, legacy flat fields are forbidden. For each pricing row, bound pairs are all-or-nothing: `min_input_tokens` with `max_input_tokens`, and `effective_from` with `effective_to`.","which_side_wins":"Structured `pricing` wins; legacy flat fields are validation-only mirrors.","optional_field_parity":"Every optional pair must round-trip both ways: present both or present neither. That applies to tier bounds, date bounds, and legacy flat aliases."},"d3_compat":{"decision":"Permanent coexistence","reason":"Consumer repos own copies of this YAML, so removing flat fields breaks them. The comment-preserving migrator would add `ruamel.yaml`, which is too costly for this release. Keep flat aliases; do not migrate-and-remove now."},"d4_sorting":{"decision":"Use `worst_case_output_cost_per_1m`: the maximum declared output rate across all rows, ignoring date tier optimism.","defense":"Cheapest-available underestimates tiered billing. Current-date-lowest-tier is time-dependent and silently reorders models at calendar boundaries. Max is stable and conservative, so verifier/fallback selection never treats a model as cheaper than it can bill.","where_it_lives":"`ai_router/pricing.py::worst_case_output_cost_per_1m(model_cfg)`; `verification.py`, `models.py`, and `utils.py` all call that helper."},"d5_confirmed_on":{"granularity":"Per model entry, not per rate row.","missing_stamp_means":"Unreviewed pricing for that model; the age is unknown.","warning_policy":"Warn once per config load only if any model is missing `confirmed_on`; do not warn per request and do not warn when the stamp is present."},"d6_cut":["migrate_router_config.py","ruamel.yaml","pricing_schedule (periods-with-nested-tiers)","global metadata.pricing_reviewed","temporary dual-form migrate-and-remove path"]}
